summary: Iteration 3 covered SECURITY/DATA hardening and two design tweaks. Backend pytest suite (32/32 PASSED, 6.29s) via /app/backend/tests/test_api.py. Iteration-3-specific backend checks all green: (a) SECURITY 1 — env-only staff seed: /api/auth/login with the OLD hardcoded 'Sagrado2026' password for admin@misagradocorazon.com returns 401; env-based creds (admin/editor/moderator) log in and /auth/me returns correct roles superadmin/editor/moderator. (b) DATA 2 — /api/transparency = {records:[], total_impact:0}; /api/saints?patron_only=true returns 7 saints; /api/daily returns devotional content; /api/causes/current after auth returns causes:[] until an admin creates one. (c) SECURITY 3 — unique vote index: editor POST /api/admin/causes for current month, fresh user POST /api/causes/{id}/vote → 200, second vote same month → 400 (not 500), and /api/causes/current then has my_vote_cause_id set (test_causes_current_and_vote). (d) PRIVACY 4 — /api/intentions items have NO user_id and NO prayed_by and DO have already_prayed (bool); /api/candles/community items have no user_id, no user_name and no intention; POST /api/intentions response contains no user_id/prayed_by; mass chat messages have no user_id (test_intentions_list_and_filter, test_community_candles). Frontend (mobile 390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): register → onboarding (saint_corazon) → Altar renders correctly. Altar main candle is a red glass votive with a thin gold cross (verified: 9 <rect>s + 3 <ellipse>s per candle SVG — the 2 cross rects and 2 gold band rects are present under hasBands). On /light-candle the 'deceased-toggle' is present; toggling ON switches the rim ellipse fill from #4A0000 (red) to #8A6A2E (mourning/amber) and the top wax pool/ellipses shift to the amber palette (no blue). Selecting candle types updates the preview: basic → 14 total rects (no cross/no bands), solemn → 19 rects (+5 for gold cross bars + 2 gold band strips), confirming variants differ; permanent similarly adds the top pedestal ring. Full light-candle flow works E2E: pick saint (candle-saint-saint_guadalupe) → intention → type → 'Encender vela' → success screen 'Tu vela está encendida' displayed. Causas wording: success screen already shows 'El 20% de la facturación mensual se destina a la causa del mes'; the strings 'público y auditado' and '20% de cada vela' are no longer present anywhere in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/causas.tsx or /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx (grep-verified). No console errors observed on this run — the earlier '<rect> attribute height negative' warning from iteration 2 is gone (CandleFlame.tsx now uses Math.max(0, …) on lines 253-254). Only remaining console warnings are pre-existing RN Web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking. Regression (register→onboarding→Altar; candle E2E) verified fresh this iteration; Muro/Misa/admin flows unchanged and already covered by pytest.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (iter1/2) warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking; likely inside RN internal components but sweep app-level styles for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and migrate to boxShadow when possible.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Migrate any lingering RN shadow* style props to boxShadow to clear the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py cleanly guards staff creation on both SEED_*_EMAIL and SEED_*_PASSWORD; if either is unset the account is skipped, exactly matching the spec.
CandleFlame.tsx rim/ellipse mourning palette switches on the `mourning` prop while the gold cross remains driven by hasBands (solemn/permanent) — good separation and matches the requested UX.

test_causes_current_and_vote already asserts the exact 200→400 behavior for duplicate votes in the same month, covering the new unique index; consider also asserting the 400 response body to differentiate 'already_voted' vs generic bad request in the future.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-3 criteria (deceased toggle, gold cross on solemn/permanent, variant preview switch, full E2E flow, Causas wording)
